label: Younger Dryas boundary
calendar_note: 12.9 to 11.7 ka BP, the Younger Dryas Impact Hypothesis window.

gaps.description: Platinum-anomaly strata at additional Younger Dryas boundary sites beyond the confirmed set, to test whether the anomaly is regional or the hemispheric layer the impact hypothesis claims.
Independent nanodiamond and microspherule re-analyses of contested boundary-layer samples, where the original identification has been disputed by later labs.
High-resolution radiocarbon dating of North American megafauna extinction relative to the boundary layer, to test synchroneity against a gradual-climate alternative.

label: Neolithic Anatolia
calendar_note: 9500 to 7000 BCE, the pre-pottery Neolithic transition around Gobekli Tepe and Catalhoyuk.

gaps.description: Lower, still-buried enclosure strata at Gobekli Tepe, to test whether monumental construction preceded or followed the shift to cultivation.
Ancient-DNA panels from early domesticated wheat and sheep lineages across the wider Fertile Crescent, to date the domestication event against the site's own occupation sequence.
The full figurine and wall-painting corpus at Catalhoyuk, cross-catalogued against Gobekli Tepe's pillar iconography for a shared or independent symbolic tradition.

label: Bronze Age collapse
calendar_note: 1200 to 1150 BCE, the Late Bronze Age collapse across the Eastern Mediterranean.

gaps.description: The final decades of Hittite royal correspondence at Hattusa, to test whether the collapse reads as sudden in the state's own contemporary record or only in retrospect.
Additional pollen and speleothem drought-proxy cores from Cyprus and the Levant, to test the multi-year-drought reading against the invasion and systems-collapse readings.
Egyptian toponym lists naming the Sea Peoples' constituent groups, cross-referenced against Aegean and Anatolian place names for a real, rather than a formulaic, origin claim.

label: Quantum history
calendar_note: 1900 to 2026 CE, the calibration control period: a well-documented, densely cited modern record this campaign already ingests (hte.corpus.quantum_history), run alongside the archaeological candidates so the selection procedure is checked against a period with a known, low missing-mass answer rather than only against periods with none.

gaps.description: Named-actor attributions for matrix-wave-mechanics, the EPR paradox, Bell's inequality, and the no-cloning theorem, currently confounded onto one catch-all actor in the shipped vocabulary (2026-09-10 run's own meta-review flag).
